# Configuration compatibility fixtures

YAML inputs are copied from v1-poc revision
b549ccd43e6102b72aa9c65ee17abfe3c429fc0b. Each adjacent JSON file was generated by
that revision's Go config.Parse, Digest, Workspace, and InferenceEndpoint
implementations. The Rust tests compare outputs without requiring Go.

These files are parser fixtures, not authorization to apply the embedded live
deployment UIDs. Live experiments must select independent identities.
